citation: Cabell, S. Q., Justice, L. M., Piasta, S. B., Curenton, S. M., Wiggins, A., Turnbull, K. P., & Petscher, Y. (2011). The impact of teacher responsivity education on preschoolers' language and literacy skills. American Journal of Speech-Language Pathology, 20(4), 315-330. https://doi.org/10.1044/1058-0360(2011/10-0104)
report_number: Journal article (American Journal of Speech-Language Pathology, ASHA), Vol. 20, 315-330. DOI 10.1044/1058-0360(2011/10-0104); PMID 21856968. Funded by US Dept of Education / IES grant R305F05124 (and NICHD P50 HD052120).
design: Cluster-randomized RCT; assignment at preschool center (school) level: 38 centers (19 intervention/25 teachers, 19 control/24 teachers); 2 cohorts across 2005-2007 in one mid-Atlantic state; 330 children (168 intervention, 162 control) sampled, 309 analyzed; low-SES Head Start (27 centers) + state pre-K (11 centers); grade = Pre-K. Intervention = ~17h teacher PD in conversational 'responsivity education' (adapted Learning Language and Loving It / Hanen) + distance coaching vs business-as-usual. Analyzed with 2-level HLM (children in centers), pretest-adjusted (fall score covariate).
problems: Paper reports Cohen's d directly in Tables 4-5 (computed from the HLM intervention-condition coefficient / pooled outcome SD); I converted to Hedges g via J=1-3/(4*df-1) with df=N-2. SDs/raw means not given for the Z-composite grammar and the alphabet composite, so g_se is derived from the coefficient SE scaled by the implied standardizing SD (coeff/d). For expressive vocabulary the implied SD (5.20) is smaller than the Table 3 spring raw SD (~8.5); the paper's reported d=0.05 is used as authoritative. Per-outcome n_t/n_c are from Table 3 component-measure columns and may differ slightly from the exact HLM analysis N (HLM N noted per row). Only print-concept knowledge showed a significant main effect; all others NS.

effect_sizes.arm_label: Responsivity education PD (single TPD arm) vs business-as-usual
effect_sizes.test_name: CELF Preschool-2 Grammar composite (Sentence Structure + Word Structure subtests, raw-score Z composite)
effect_sizes.timepoint: spring (end of academic year; ~6-8 mo post-baseline)
effect_sizes.g_method: g = J*d_reported; paper reports Cohen's d=0.10 = HLM intervention-condition coefficient gamma01 (residualized fall->spring gain) / pooled outcome SD. J=1-3/(4*df-1), df=N-2=226. g_se = J*(SE_coeff/SD_implied), SD_implied=coeff/d=1.70.
effect_sizes.notes: HLM 2-level (children in centers), pretest-adjusted (fall score centered predictor). gamma01 p=.42 (NS). n_t/n_c are Table 3 component ns for sentence structure; HLM grammar composite N=228. Grammar composite is a Z-score composite (M=0, SD~1), consistent with SD_implied=1.70.

effect_sizes.arm_label: Responsivity education PD (single TPD arm) vs business-as-usual
effect_sizes.test_name: CELF Preschool-2 Expressive Vocabulary subtest (raw, max 40)
effect_sizes.timepoint: spring (end of academic year; ~6-8 mo post-baseline)
effect_sizes.g_method: g = J*d_reported; d=0.05 = coeff/pooled SD. J: df=N-2=227. SD_implied=coeff/d=5.20 (note: smaller than Table 3 spring SD ~8.5; paper's pooled/standardizing SD differs - d_reported used as authoritative). g_se=J*(SE/SD_implied).
effect_sizes.notes: HLM gamma01 p=.78 (NS). Table 3 spring M(SD): int 19.27(8.52), ctrl 19.21(8.57). SD_implied(5.20) is lower than raw spring SD; the reported Cohen's d=0.05 is taken as authoritative per the paper.

effect_sizes.arm_label: Responsivity education PD (single TPD arm) vs business-as-usual
effect_sizes.timepoint: spring (end of academic year; ~6-8 mo post-baseline)
effect_sizes.g_method: g = J*d_reported; d=0.13 = coeff/pooled SD. J: df=N-2=238. SD_implied=coeff/d=17.69 (~ Table 3 spring SD 19.75, consistent). g_se=J*(SE/SD_implied).
effect_sizes.notes: HLM gamma01 p=.15 (NS). SD_implied 17.69 close to full-sample spring SD 19.75, confirming standardizer = outcome SD.

effect_sizes.arm_label: Responsivity education PD (single TPD arm) vs business-as-usual
effect_sizes.test_name: Preschool Print and Word Awareness Test (PWPA, 14-item, max 17)
effect_sizes.timepoint: spring (end of academic year; ~6-8 mo post-baseline)
effect_sizes.g_method: g = J*d_reported; d=0.39 = coeff/pooled SD. J: df=N-2=232. SD_implied=coeff/d=3.69 (matches Table 3 full-sample spring SD 3.67 -> validates b/s standardization). g_se=J*(SE/SD_implied).
effect_sizes.notes: Only SIGNIFICANT main effect: HLM gamma01 p=.004 (survives Benjamini-Hochberg). Reported as the study's positive emergent-literacy finding. SD_implied 3.69 ~ spring SD 3.67 confirms standardizer.

effect_sizes.arm_label: Responsivity education PD (single TPD arm) vs business-as-usual
effect_sizes.test_name: PALS Preschool Upper-Case + Lower-Case Alphabet Knowledge composite (sum, max 52)
effect_sizes.timepoint: spring (end of academic year; ~6-8 mo post-baseline)
effect_sizes.g_method: g = J*d_reported; d=0.24 = coeff/pooled SD. J: df=N-2=244. SD_implied=coeff/d=19.42 (composite of uppercase+lowercase). g_se=J*(SE/SD_implied).
effect_sizes.notes: HLM gamma01 p=.10 (NS). Composite of two PALS subtests (Table 3 spring SDs: uppercase 10.01, lowercase 9.43); n_t/n_c are uppercase component ns; HLM composite N=246.
